---
title: "Network Explorer"
page-layout: article        # removes the content column margins
margin-left: "0px"
margin-right: "0px"
---

```{=html}
<div id="network-root">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="network-scoped.css">

<style>
  #network-root {
    height: calc(100vh - 150px); /* 60px = Quarto navbar, adjust if needed */
  }
</style>

<header class="header">

  <div class="controls">
    <!-- Simulated Data (lines 1-2) -->
    <span class="control-section-title">Simulated Data</span>
    <div class="filter-group">
      <label for="filter-N" class="filter-label">N:</label>
      <select id="filter-N" class="filter-select"></select>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-group">
      <label for="filter-M" class="filter-label">M:</label>
      <select id="filter-M" class="filter-select"></select>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-group">
      <label for="filter-openmindedness" class="filter-label">Open:</label>
      <select id="filter-openmindedness" class="filter-select"></select>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-group">
      <label for="filter-post" class="filter-label">Post:</label>
      <select id="filter-post" class="filter-select">
        <option value="F">Feed</option>
        <option value="S">Social</option>
        <option value="FS">Both</option>
      </select>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-group">
      <label for="filter-seed" class="filter-label">Seed:</label>
      <select id="filter-seed" class="filter-select"></select>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-group">
      <label for="filter-t" class="filter-label">t:</label>
      <select id="filter-t" class="filter-select"></select>
    </div>

    <div class="filter-status" id="filter-status">No files</div>   

    <div class="filter-group">
      <label for="filter-run" class="filter-label">Run:</label>
      <select id="filter-run" class="filter-select" style="min-width:110px;"></select>
    </div>

    <div class="loaded-filename">
      File:
       <span class="loaded-filename" id="loaded-name"></span>
    </div>

    <div class="legend">
      <div class="legend__item" id="legend-agents">
        <div class="legend__dot" style="background:var(--color-agent)"></div>
        <span>Agents (<span id="count-agents">0</span>)</span>
      </div>
      <div class="legend__item" id="legend-stmts">
        <div class="legend__dot" style="background:var(--color-stmt)"></div>
        <span>Statements (<span id="count-stmts">0</span>)</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="controls__linebreak"></div>
  

    <!-- Network Type (line 3) -->
    <span class="control-section-title">Network Type</span>
    <div class="filter-group" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;">
      <select id="filter-nettype" class="filter-select" style="min-width:175px;">
        <option value="AS">Agent–Statement</option>
        <option value="AA">Projection: Agents</option>
        <option value="SS">Projection: Statements</option>
      </select>
    </div>

    <button class="btn" id="btn-weight-forces" disabled title="Use edge weight to scale attraction force (projection networks only)">Weight forces: off</button>

    <div class="control-group">
      <label class="control-group__label" title="Hide links with weight below this threshold (projection networks only).">MIN WEIGHT</label>
      <input type="range" class="slider" id="sl-minweight" min="1" max="10" step="1" value="1" disabled>
      <span class="control-group__value" id="vl-minweight">1</span>
    </div>

    <div class="controls__linebreak"></div>

    <!-- Network Layout (line 4-5) -->
    <span class="control-section-title">Dynamic Layout</span>
    <div class="control-group">
      <label class="control-group__label" title="Repulsion between all nodes: Higher values push nodes further apart (Fruchterman-Reingold repulsive force).">SPREAD</label>
      <input type="range" class="slider" id="sl-spread" min="10" max="400" step="5" value="100">
      <span class="control-group__value" id="vl-spread">100</span>
    </div>

    <div class="control-group">
      <label class="control-group__label" title="Preferred distance between connected nodes: The rest length of the spring pulling them together.">EDGE LENGTH</label>
      <input type="range" class="slider" id="sl-edgelen" min="10" max="100" step="2" value="10">
      <span class="control-group__value" id="vl-edgelen">10</span>
    </div>

    <div class="control-group">
      <label class="control-group__label" title="How strongly edges pull connected nodes toward each other: Higher values create tighter clusters.">ATTRACTION</label>
      <input type="range" class="slider" id="sl-attract" min="0" max="1" step="0.02" value="0.75">
      <span class="control-group__value" id="vl-attract">0.75</span>
    </div>

    <div class="controls__linebreak"></div>
    
    <button class="btn" id="btn-reset">&#x21BA; Reset</button>
    <button class="btn" id="btn-defaults">Default Controls</button>

    <div class="divider"></div>

    <button class="btn" id="btn-freeze">&#x23F8; Freeze</button>
    <button class="btn" id="btn-labels">Labels off</button>
    <button class="btn" id="btn-size">Statement size: uniform</button>

  </div>

</header>

<div class="canvas-wrapper" id="canvas-wrapper">
  <svg class="graph-svg" id="graph"></svg>

  <!-- Zoom controls: positioned top-left below main controls -->
  <div class="zoom-controls" id="zoom-controls">
    <button class="btn btn--zoom" id="btn-zoom-in" title="Zoom in">+</button>
    <button class="btn btn--zoom" id="btn-zoom-out" title="Zoom out">−</button>
  </div>

  <!-- Small cursor tooltip: shows on hover for statements and brief agent info -->
  <div class="cursor-tooltip" id="cursor-tooltip"></div>

  <!-- Worldview pane: opens on agent click, lists connected statements -->
  <div class="worldview-pane" id="worldview-pane">
    <div class="worldview-pane__header">
      <div class="worldview-pane__title" id="worldview-title"></div>
      <button class="worldview-pane__close" id="worldview-close">&#x2715;</button>
    </div>
    <div class="worldview-pane__list" id="worldview-list"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- Statement pane: opens on statement click, lists connected agents -->
  <div class="worldview-pane" id="statement-pane">
    <div class="worldview-pane__header">
      <div class="worldview-pane__title" id="statement-title"></div>
      <button class="worldview-pane__close" id="statement-close">&#x2715;</button>
    </div>
    <div class="worldview-pane__list" id="statement-list"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="status-bar" id="status-bar">Initialising&hellip;</div>
</div>

<style>
  /* Let Quarto's body/main have no extra padding */
  main.content { padding: 0 !important; }

  /* Make canvas-wrapper fill whatever remains below the header */
  #canvas-wrapper {
    height: calc(100vh - var(--quarto-navbar-height, 60px) - var(--header-height, 0px));
  }
</style>

<script>
  // Measure the actual .header height and set it as a CSS variable
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const h = document.querySelector('.header');
    if (h) {
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--header-height', h.offsetHeight + 'px');
    }
  });
</script>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/d3/7.8.5/d3.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/d3/7.8.5/d3.min.js"></script>
<script src="network-core.js"></script>
<script src="network-controls.js"></script>

<script>
// Initialize the network explorer when DOM is ready
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  // Create visualization instance
  const viz = new NetworkViz('canvas-wrapper');
  
  // Initialize interactive controls (filters, dropdowns, file upload, etc.)
  initControls(viz, 'manifest.json');
});
</script>
</div>
```
